auth.subtitle: Growing Degree Days Monitor
auth.hasAccount: Already have an account? Sign In
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters

dashboard.noFieldsDesc: Add your first field to start tracking Growing Degree Days.
dashboard.noFieldsSharedDesc: This shared farm has no fields yet.
dashboard.welcomeDesc: A farm groups your fields under a weather station. Place a pin on the map to auto-assign the nearest station.

field.deleteConfirm: Delete this field and all its data?
field.kcNonlinearDesc: Active: Non-linear Kc formula (Glenn et al. 2011)
field.kcChartNote: Both curves shown on chart. Toggle selects which drives ETc/water balance.

fieldForm.noConeatOverlap: No CONEAT groups overlap with this field polygon. You can enter TAW manually.
fieldForm.drawPolygonForConeat: Draw a field polygon above to auto-detect soil from CONEAT map.
fieldForm.selectConeatValue: Select a value — MM (soil storage) or APDN (adjusted for landscape):
fieldForm.waterBalanceNote: Water balance will track soil water 0–{{taw}} mm. Irrigation advisory triggers below {{threshold}} mm.
fieldForm.deleteWarning: Deleting this field will permanently remove all seasons and associated data.

season.autoCloseNote: The previous active season will be automatically closed.
season.deleteSeasonConfirm: Delete this season and all its data?
season.undoHarvestConfirm: Reactivate this season? The harvest date will be removed.

settings.locationNotSet: Not set — tap Edit to place pin
settings.stationSortNote: Sorted by distance from farm. Closer stations provide more accurate weather data.
settings.accountNote: Your fields and weather data are stored on the server and synced across devices.
settings.setLocationFirst: Set a farm location first to see stations sorted by distance.

irrigation.title: Irrigation
irrigation.noEquipmentYet: No irrigation equipment yet. Add your first pivot or sprinkler.
irrigation.agSenseUrlNote: Open the "Applied by Day" report in AgSense 365 and copy the URL.
irrigation.autoCloseNote: Previous open assignment will be auto-closed the day before this start date.
irrigation.noAssignments: No assignments yet. Use "+ Move" to assign this equipment to a field.

charts.gddFootnote: Bars = daily GDD (left axis), Line = cumulative (right axis). Dashed lines = growth stages.
charts.gddFootnoteWithPtu: Orange bars = daily GDD, purple bars = daily PTU. Blue line = cum. GDD, dashed purple = cum. PTU.
charts.etoFootnote: FAO Penman-Monteith method. Bars = daily ETo (left axis), Line = cumulative (right axis).
charts.etoFootnoteRain: ETo: FAO Penman-Monteith. Blue bars = daily ETo, Teal bars = daily rainfall, Lines = cumulative.
charts.etoFootnoteRainIrrig: ETo: FAO Penman-Monteith. Blue bars = daily ETo, Teal bars = daily rainfall, Orange bars = daily irrigation, Lines = cumulative.
charts.ndviFootnote: Sentinel-2 NDVI (green). Solid Kc = active formula for ETc. Dashed Kc = alternative. Cloud-filtered.
charts.ndviTapToView: Tap a point to view satellite imagery
charts.waterBalanceFootnote: ETc = ETo x Kc (NDVI-derived). Balance = Cumulative Rain{{irrig}} - Cumulative ETc. Positive = surplus, Negative = deficit.
charts.calibrationNote: {{count}} reading(s) without SM% — need at least 3 overpasses with >1 dB spread to calibrate.

weather.distanceWarning: Station is {{distance}} km away. ETo and weather estimates may be less accurate at this distance.

sharing.title: Share {{type}}: {{name}}
sharing.description: Shared users get read-only access — they can view data but cannot edit.

calendar.title: Edit Daily Values
calendar.footerNote: Tap a date to override rain or irrigation values. Overrides replace station/equipment data for that day.

alerts.soilWiltingPoint: Soil water at wilting point. Irrigate immediately — apply {{amount}} mm to reach 80% field capacity.
alerts.soilBelowThreshold: Soil water below safety threshold ({{pct}}% available). Consider irrigating — apply {{amount}} mm to reach 80% field capacity.
alerts.deleteFarmConfirm: Delete farm "{{name}}" and all its fields?
alerts.stationChanged: Weather station changed on {{date}}. Data before that date comes from {{oldStation}}.
alerts.stationChangeConfirm: Station updated across {{fields}} field(s). {{seasons}} active season(s) will show a mixed-station notice.
alerts.stationDataGap: Warning: the new station may not have data covering your earliest active season.

vernalization.title: Vernalization (Cold Hours)
vernalization.description: Vernalization = hours at 0-7°C. Required for reproductive transition.

radiation.title: Solar Radiation — {{period}}
radiation.description: Solar radiation accumulated during the critical reproductive window. Higher radiation = higher yield potential.
radiation.alertApproaching: Critical radiation period ({{period}}) approaching in ~{{days}} days
radiation.alertPoorRadiation: Low radiation during critical period: {{current}} MJ/m² (adequate: {{target}} MJ/m²)
radiation.alertWaterStress: Water stress during critical radiation window: {{days}} days below MAD threshold
radiation.waterStressWarning: Water stress: {{days}} days ({{pct}}%) below MAD — reduced radiation use

photoperiod.title: Photoperiod & PTU — {{crop}}
photoperiod.description: Short-day plant — flowering triggered when daylength drops below critical threshold.

ndviImage.title: Satellite Imagery
ndviImage.ndviExplanation: Green = healthy vegetation. Gray = clouds. Brown = bare soil.

farmMap.title: Farm Map
farmMap.noCoords: No farms have coordinates set. Edit a farm to add a map pin.
farmMap.tapPin: Tap a pin to switch to that farm.

VE.name: Emergence
VE.desc: Shoot emerges from soil; photosynthesis begins

V1.name: First Leaf
V1.desc: First leaf collar visible; nodal roots emerging

V2.name: Second Leaf
V2.desc: Plant relies on seed energy; seminal roots at max size

V3.name: Third Leaf
V3.desc: Seed no longer contributing; plant dependent on photosynthesis

V6.name: Sixth Leaf
V6.desc: Growing point above soil; nodal root system dominant

V8.name: Eighth Leaf
V8.desc: Rapid growth phase; ear shoots visible

V9.name: Ninth Leaf
V9.desc: Kernel row number being fixed; brace roots developing

V12.name: Twelfth Leaf
V12.desc: All leaves formed; ~10% total dry matter accumulated

V15.name: Fifteenth Leaf
V15.desc: Kernels per row being determined; ~2 weeks from silking

V17.name: Seventeenth Leaf
V17.desc: Increasing vulnerability to hail and moisture stress

VT.name: Tassel
VT.desc: Tassel emergence; 65% of N, 50% of P, 85% of K taken up

R2.name: Blister
R2.desc: Kernels at 85% moisture; nutrient translocation begins

R4.name: Dough
R4.desc: ~50% maximum dry weight; kernels at 70% moisture

R6.name: Maturity
R6.desc: Black layer formed; 30-35% moisture; final yield determined

VC.name: Cotyledon
VC.desc: Unifoliolate leaves unrolled; cotyledons fully open

V3.name: Third Node
V3.desc: Rapid vegetative growth begins; N fixation increasing

V5.name: Fifth Node
V5.desc: Canopy closing; peak N fixation approaching

R1.name: Begin Bloom
R1.desc: First flower on any node; photoperiod sensitive

R2.name: Full Bloom
R2.desc: Open flower at one of two uppermost nodes

R3.name: Begin Pod
R3.desc: Pod 5mm at one of four uppermost nodes

R4.name: Full Pod
R4.desc: Pod 2cm at one of four uppermost nodes

R5.name: Begin Seed
R5.desc: Seed 3mm in pod at upper nodes; rapid seed fill

R6.name: Full Seed
R6.desc: Green seed fills pod cavity at upper nodes

R7.name: Begin Maturity
R7.desc: One mature pod on main stem; leaves yellowing

R8.name: Full Maturity
R8.desc: 95% of pods mature; harvest ready at 13% moisture

S.name: Seedling
S.desc: First leaf unfolded; seminal roots active

T.name: Tillering
T.desc: Tillers forming from crown; root system expanding

SE.name: Stem Extension
SE.desc: Internodes elongating; vernalization must be met

BT.name: Booting
BT.desc: Flag leaf sheath swelling with head inside

HD.name: Heading
HD.desc: Head emerging from flag leaf sheath

ML.name: Milk
ML.desc: Kernel contains milky liquid; grain filling

DG.name: Dough
DG.desc: Kernel contents doughy; losing green color

SE.name: Stem Elongation
SE.desc: Bolting begins; internodes elongating; vernalization must be met

IE.name: Inflorescence Emergence
IE.desc: Flower buds visible in terminal cluster

FF.name: First Flower
FF.desc: 10% flowers open; critical yield determination begins

SF.name: Seed Filling
SF.desc: Seeds filling; turning from green to brown

MT.name: Maturity
MT.desc: Seeds dark brown/black; pods dry; harvest ready
